Machine dialog for operator@sbforgtech.com opens with title 'Assign machine to Suresh Patil' and asset combobox (62 options). All backend audit-log entries (user.create/user.update/user.deactivate/alarm.ack/module.toggle) recorded and filterable via ?action and ?q. Modules EEMS/OEE_APS gates verified: disable→403, then re-enabled. Duplicate email→409, supervisor POST user→403, delete self→400, last-TA→400, assign self→400, delete PLATFORM tenant→400, dup tenant code→409 all verified.

critical.issue: plant_comparison array still returns all 3 plants when plant_id filter is applied. The comp_rows query in server.py energy_summary() (line ~1564) hard-codes {'tenant_id': user.tenant_id, 'date': {'$gte': week_cutoff}} and never merges plant_id filter. Spec (iteration 4) requires the comparison to narrow to just the selected plant.

issues: Row actions Edit / Deactivate use icon-only buttons with no data-testid or aria-label — hard to target in tests. Consider aria-label='Edit user' / 'Deactivate user' or add data-testid=user-row-edit / user-row-deactivate.

Uses shadcn Select (custom button + combobox popover) — this is fine visually but native <select> would be zero-JS. Confirmed working after clicking the trigger button; not a bug, just a testing note.

action_items: Fix /api/energy/summary comp_rows query to honor plant_id filter (merge {'plant_id': plant_id} into comp_rows find when plant_id is provided). One-line change around server.py:1564.
Add data-testid or aria-label attributes to Users row Edit/Deactivate icon buttons to improve future automated testing (already flagged in prior iterations).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1853 lines — still needs to be split into routers (platform.py, energy.py, oee.py, audit.py, users.py). Guideline threshold is 700.

energy_summary() computes plant_comparison over a hard-coded 7-day window regardless of the ?range param — the chart label correctly reads 'Plant comparison (last 7 days)' but the KPI cards use the requested range, so users switching to 30d see inconsistent scopes. Consider using the same window OR make the label dynamic.

platform_delete_tenant() hard-deletes across 13 collections in a loop without a session/transaction — a partial failure would leave orphaned data. Wrap in a client_session().start_transaction() or at minimum log and continue.
TenantCreate.admin_password is unvalidated (no min length / complexity). All other password-accepting endpoints have the same gap. Add pydantic constr(min_length=6) or explicit validation.
record_audit is fire-and-forget awaited inline in the request path. For high-frequency actions (alarm ack under a storm) this doubles DB writes per request; consider a background queue.

PlatformAdmin.jsx renders outside the shared Layout via BareProtected — good, but header 'Platform Admin' user block appears clipped in top-right (visible in screenshot with only 'Platform Admi' and a partial 'n' under nav bar). Minor CSS clip.
AuditPage renders 'entity_id' truncated with '…' — hover-title would help admins copy the full id.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The only functional gap is the plant_id filter on /api/energy/summary — expected to narrow plant_comparison but returns all 3. All UI flows work. If you need to test the Users icon-buttons, target row buttons by index: btns.nth(-2) = Edit (pencil), btns.nth(-1) = Deactivate. Machine assign dialog uses shadcn combobox (role='combobox') with 62 options. EEMS/OEE range switch uses shadcn Select — click the button then click role='option'. Ended state: EEMS & OEE_APS modules re-enabled; REPORTS was toggled true during audit tests (leave as-is).
rca of the issue: energy_summary() builds two separate DB queries: (1) `q` for the KPIs+series, which correctly appends {'plant_id': plant_id}; and (2) `comp_rows` for plant_comparison, which is a fresh find({'tenant_id': ..., 'date': {'$gte': week_cutoff}}) and never picks up plant_id. Merging plant_id into the comp_rows filter (or, more correctly, keeping comp_rows unfiltered but excluding it from the returned payload when plant_id is set) will satisfy the spec.
